interpretation: Documented UniProt field convention, not independent validation of an Ensembl object or an experimental identity.

sources.title: UniProt Knowledgebase User Manual
sources.supports: EnsemblFungi resource identifier, first optional field and second optional field denote transcript, protein and gene roles respectively; one string may occupy several roles.

sources.title: UniProt Core DR converter
sources.supports: The first DR attribute becomes the cross-reference model ID; subsequent attributes become database-defined properties.

sources.title: UniProt Core JSON cross-reference serialization tests
sources.supports: The model ID serializes as JSON id; named property keys and values remain distinct. The test uses Ensembl, not a biological PHI-base example.
